steps.note: Enable the PR activity history required by the case.
Apply the required tenant configuration for event withdrawal visibility.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Show open purchase requisitions, where the sourced PR must be selected.

args.goal: open an open purchase requisition that was sourced once, open its history or activity view, and stop on the screen showing every available activity entry including created, approved, assigned, sourced in event RFX-xxxx, and any withdrawal or ordering entry if present

steps.note: Navigate to the appropriate sourced PR and verify its activity history on the buyer screen.
Confirm the resulting PR history screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or malformed values.
